submission_format: A single Python module named solution.py

evaluation.pass_rule: All correctness tests pass and the weighted score is at least 0.7

title: Build a Classifier
summary: Implement logistic regression from scratch with NumPy and reach at least 93% test accuracy on a real medical dataset.
requirements: sigmoid(z) must be numerically stable for very large |z| (no overflow, no NaN)
predict_proba(X, w, b) returns probabilities of class 1
gradients(X, y, w, b) returns (dw, db) of the mean binary cross-entropy
train(X, y, lr, epochs) returns (w, b) using batch gradient descent
Test accuracy on the standardised breast-cancer dataset must be at least 0.93
description: The hidden tests standardise scikit-learn's bundled breast-cancer dataset, split it with a fixed seed, train with your code and check accuracy. They also gradient-check your `gradients` function against finite differences.
